item.title: Version 1.3.0
item.description:
New

  • Inter font: bundled Inter Variable as default app font
  • Font customization: pick from 15 font families and adjust size (7–13) in Settings
  • 3-column watchlist: Symbol, Price (with day range), and Change — click headers to sort
  • Grand total: combined value and P&L across all portfolios shown at the top
  • Ticker mode: menu bar cycles through watchlist stocks every 5 seconds
  • Portfolio recap mode: menu bar shows total portfolio value + P&L %
  • Search results now show asset type badge (EQUITY, ETF, MUTUALFUND, etc.)
  • Reset to Default Settings with confirmation (preserves watchlist & portfolios)
  • Tab persistence: reopening the popover restores the last viewed tab
  • Release notes in Sparkle update dialog

Fixed

  • Replaced fatalError crash with fallback when Application Support is unavailable
  • Converted force-unwrapped properties to safe Optionals
  • Fixed tick batch timer not invalidated on system sleep
  • Fixed popover height mismatch (580 → 520)
  • Avg price now pre-filled when adding a holding
  • Absolute change in watchlist now colored green/red
  • Fixed Best & Worst display with single watchlist stock
  • Fixed isRefreshing race condition
  • Thread safety: panel callbacks now use Task { @MainActor in } instead of DispatchQueue
  • Added NotificationCenter observer cleanup on app terminate

item.title: Version 1.2.1
item.description:
Fixed

  • Popover: fixed gap below menu bar
  • Thread safety: import callback and debounce Task now run on @MainActor
  • Validation: added qty > 0 and price > 0 checks on all holding forms
  • Removed all debug print() statements

Changed

  • Portfolio tab: standardized font sizes to match watchlist tab

item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.description:
New

  • Universal binary (arm64 + x86_64): now runs natively on Intel Macs

item.title: Version 1.1.1
item.description:
Fixed

  • Real-time balance: REST polling now refreshes quotes every 60s as fallback
  • Sparkle: skip initialization when SUFeedURL is missing, preventing crash in dev mode

item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
New

  • Portfolio export: save all portfolios or a single one to a JSON file
  • Portfolio import: load portfolios from JSON with UUID regeneration and duplicate name handling

item.title: Version 1.0.2
item.description:
Fixed

  • Sparkle: added Frameworks rpath so auto-update framework loads correctly

item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description:
Fixed

  • Sparkle: Check for Updates button now works correctly
  • Memory: reduced footprint by disabling URLSession cache
  • Popover: contentViewController released on close, preventing memory leaks

Changed

  • App icon updated from SB to SD branding

item.title: Version 1.0
item.description:
New

  • Real-time stock prices via Yahoo Finance WebSocket
  • Multiple portfolios with P&L tracking in your preferred currency
  • Watchlist with daily performance sorting
  • Currency conversion with historical exchange rates
  • Extended hours support (pre-market & after-hours)
  • 8 customizable menu bar display modes
  • Sparkle auto-update built in
